# My Zini Digital ERP

> All-in-one School, Coaching, and Institution Management ERP software (`https://digitalerp.shop` / `https://myzini.digitalerp.shop`). Registration Fee: ₹100.

## Core Documentation & Pages
- [Home & Registration](https://digitalerp.shop/): Main product overview, 50+ ERP features, pricing plans, and institution registration (₹100 Registration Fee).
- [Live ERP Portal](https://myzini.digitalerp.shop/): School administration dashboard.
- [Knowledge Base & Guides Hub](https://digitalerp.shop/blogs/): Searchable index of all verified Hinglish & English school ERP tutorials.
- [Best School Management Software in India](https://digitalerp.shop/school-management-software.html): Complete school ERP overview covering admissions, attendance, fees, results, ID cards, transport, and hostel.
- [School Fee Management Software](https://digitalerp.shop/school-fee-management-software.html): Automated fee collection, pending dues radar, sibling concessions, and WhatsApp fee reminders.
- [RFID School Attendance System](https://digitalerp.shop/school-attendance-rfid-software.html): RFID smart card attendance polling, exit tracking, and daily/monthly reports.
- [Coaching Management Software](https://digitalerp.shop/coaching-management-software.html): Batch timetables, fee dues, test results, and FCM announcements for coaching institutes.
- [Free CBSE CGPA & Marks Percentage Calculator](https://digitalerp.shop/tools/cbse-cgpa-percentage-calculator.html): Free online CGPA to percentage and grade calculator.
- [Free Attendance Percentage Calculator](https://digitalerp.shop/tools/attendance-percentage-calculator.html): Free 75% attendance target calculator for students and schools.
- [Free School Fee Receipt Generator](https://digitalerp.shop/tools/school-fee-receipt-generator.html): Free printable school fee receipt maker online.
- [Free School TC & Bonafide Generator](https://digitalerp.shop/tools/transfer-certificate-generator.html): Free printable Transfer Certificate (TC) and Bonafide Student Certificate maker online.
- [Free School Transfer Certificate & Bonafide Generator](https://digitalerp.shop/tools/transfer-certificate-generator.html): Free printable TC & Bonafide certificate generator for schools.
- [Best School Management Software in Bihar & Patna](https://digitalerp.shop/school-management-software-bihar.html): Regional school ERP guide for CBSE, ICSE, and BSEB schools in Bihar & Patna.
